## Advice for Managing Sleep Apnea and Irregular Exercise
1. Use your prescribed CPAP machine consistently every night to manage sleep apnea effectively.
2. Maintain a healthy weight through a balanced diet and regular exercise to reduce apnea severity.
3. Avoid alcohol and sedatives before bedtime, as they can worsen sleep apnea symptoms.
4. Try sleeping on your side instead of your back to help keep your airway open.
5. Establish a regular exercise routine by scheduling workouts at the same time each day, starting with small, achievable goals like 15-minute walks.
6. Choose physical activities you enjoy, such as brisk walking, swimming, or cycling, to stay motivated and consistent.
7. Track your exercise progress and sleep quality to identify patterns and stay accountable.
